title: C2 Milestone 9
completion_message: ¡Magistral! Has superado el Milestone 9. Entiendes las leyes del mercado global, dominas la persuasión retórica y manejas la gramática más elitista del idioma. Tu ascenso a la cumbre del C2 es imparable.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes: 

1. Advanced Conditionals: 
- HAD I KNOWN (If I had known). 
- WERE HE TO RESIGN (If he resigned). 
- SHOULD YOU NEED (If you need). 
- Mixed: If I had bought it, I WOULD BE rich now. 

2. Corporate Governance: 
- Shareholders vs Stakeholders. 
- Fiduciary duty. 
- Board of Directors. 
- Hostile takeover.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 9, Executive Mastery. This exam will test your mastery of recent lessons. First, Advanced Conditionals. Remember the inversion: HAD I KNOWN, WERE HE TO RESIGN, and SHOULD YOU NEED. Also remember Mixed Conditionals for past actions with present results. Second, Corporate Governance vocabulary. Terms like Shareholders, Stakeholders, Fiduciary duty, and Hostile takeover.

parts.visual:
3. Persuasion & Rhetoric: 
- The Rule of Three (Fast, smart, cheap). 
- Anaphora (We will fight. We will win). 
- Rhetorical questions. 
- Antithesis (Small risk, giant reward). 
- Hyperbole & Understatement. 

4. Macroeconomics: 
- Inflation & Interest rates. 
- GDP (Gross Domestic Product). 
- Bull vs Bear market. 
- Protectionism & Tariffs.
parts.audio: Third, Persuasion and Rhetoric. Mastering Rhetorical Devices like the Rule of Three, Anaphora, Rhetorical questions, Antithesis, and Hyperbole. Finally, Macroeconomics. Global financial terms like Inflation, Interest rates, GDP, Bull and Bear markets, and Tariffs. Good luck on the exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu liderazgo retórico y financiero en este examen de consolidación.

questions.question: Normal: If I had listened to you, I wouldn't have lost the money. -> Inversion: ____ to you, I wouldn't have lost the money.
questions.explanation: Inversión del 3er condicional: Had I listened.

questions.question: The CEO must balance the needs of all ____, not just the financial shareholders.
'This software is intuitive, powerful, and affordable.' This is an example of the Rule of ____.
Due to rising ____, the cost of living is increasing rapidly, destroying purchasing power.
Normal: If you need any further documents, please let me know. -> Inversion: ____ any further documents, please let me know.
questions.explanation: Inversión del 1er condicional: Should you need.

questions.question: The Board members have a ____ duty to protect the investors' financial interests.
'We cannot surrender. We cannot fail. We cannot back down.' Repeating the start of the sentence is called ____.
To protect local industries, the government imposed high ____ on imported electronics. (Aranceles).
Normal: If the CEO resigned, the stock would crash. -> Inversion: ____, the stock would crash.
Since I cannot attend the shareholders' meeting in person, I will cast a ____ vote. (Voto por poder).
'It's a small mistake for the developer, but a catastrophic failure for the launch.' This contrast is an ____.
When the stock market is rising rapidly and investors are buying, it is a ____ market.
Mixed Conditional: If I had invested in that startup ten years ago, I ____ a billionaire right now.
When a company buys back its own shares, it's called a share ____.
'Do we really want our competitor to win?' This is a ____ question.
The total value of all goods and services produced in a country is its ____ (PIB).
____ it not been for the government bailout, the bank would have collapsed.
questions.explanation: Had it not been for = si no hubiera sido por.

questions.question: When an executive uses secret company data to trade stocks, it is called ____ trading.
'The server room catching fire was a slight hiccup.' This is an example of an ____. (Atenuación irónica).
The central bank decided to raise interest ____ to slow down the economy.
____ I known... (Inversión 3er condicional)
____ you need help... (Inversión 1er condicional)
The ____ of Directors. (Junta con B)
A ____ vote. (Voto delegado con P)
Fast, smart, and safe. The Rule of ____.
Do we want to fail? A ____ question.
High ____ raises prices. (Inflación)
The ____ chain. (Cadena de suministro con S)
A ____ market. (Mercado alcista con B)
Import ____. (Aranceles con T)
